university.name: University of the Assumption
university.location: Unisite Subd., Del Pilar, City of San Fernando, Pampanga 2000
university.description: Archdiocesan Catholic university in San Fernando, Pampanga — the first archdiocesan Catholic university in Asia. Offers PAASCU-accredited undergraduate and graduate programs across eight schools and colleges, with strong board programs in nursing, pharmacy, accountancy, architecture, engineering, and teacher education.
university.tuition: Approximately P20,000–P45,000 per semester (regular programs; Nursing and Pharmacy typically higher — AY 2026-2027 initial enrollment P5,000 regular / P8,000 CONP; full assessment via SERP; verify with Finance Office)
popularCourses: Bachelor of Secondary Education (Major in Values Education with Religious Education)

courses_research_notes: Crosswalk: uniRank top-100 rank 69 'University of Assumption' = runtime id 'ua' (University of the Assumption). Eight college units (official academics + enrollment): SAS — Communication, Criminology, Human Services, Psychology; CONP — Nursing, Pharmacy; SOB — Business Administration, Hospitality Management, Tourism Management; COA — Accountancy, Accounting Information System; SED — Elementary Education, Secondary Education (Values Education with Religious Education); CEA — Civil, Computer and Industrial Engineering, Architecture; CIT — Information Technology; BLIS listed under UACET board programs. Graduate school also offered (not in popularCourses). Homepage highlights strong licensure outcomes (Architecture, CPA). Tuition: UA does not publish full per-program fee tables online; enrollment memo gives initial-payment tiers only.
